text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
You're kidding! We don't have the money to 
take my companions overseas?! Reality 
never stops haunting me, does it?

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
In order to build the "Eternal Castle," 
"expanding worldwide" is non-negotiable. 
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is also a 
promise made to the sponsor who provided 
our base of operations.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Are you telling me I have to leave my 
friends behind and accept not being able 
to celebrate that glorious moment with 
them? I need to think.
